title: BTS Releases Official Dual Book Series: 'Lyrics Inside' and 'Recipe Book'
detail: September 15, 2026 — BTS's first officially licensed book series arrived at US retailers via Hachette Book Group's Running Press imprint. 'BTS Lyrics Inside' (184 pages, $28.00 hardcover / $14.99 ebook) breaks down 10 songs spanning the 'Most Beautiful Moment in Life' era through 2022's 'Proof' anthology — including 'Boy With Luv,' 'ON,' 'Life Goes On,' 'IDOL' and 'FIRE' — with full Hangul lyrics, romanization, line-by-line English notes and commentary from RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V and Jung Kook. Its companion, 'BTS Recipe Book' (256 pages, $30.00 hardcover), features 15 Korean dishes drawn from 'Run BTS!,' 'Bon Voyage' and 'In the Soop,' with step-by-step visual guides, QR-linked recipe videos and member commentary. Both titles were first announced June 15, 2026 during BTS FESTA.
